About SPD Logistics

Super Pak Data Goods Transport Co. has been Pakistan's trusted commercial freight and goods carrier since 1996, delivering cargo safely across every province.

Company History (Est. 1996)

Founded in 1996 by Faisal Hussain Bhatti as Super Pak Data Goods Transport Co., establishing a legacy of trust, reliability, and logistical dependability across Pakistan.

28+ Years Experience

Nearly three decades of proven operational excellence handling raw materials, textiles, industrial machinery, and consumer commodities safely and on time.

Nationwide Logistics Solutions

Extensive trunk route network covering Karachi, Hyderabad, Sukkur, Multan, Faisalabad, Lahore, Gujranwala, Rawalpindi/Islamabad, and northern distribution hubs.

Warehouse Operations

Strategic warehousing infrastructure in Karachi (Hawksbay Rd Truck Stand) and Lahore for secure staging, cargo consolidation, and efficient cross-docking.

Bilty Tracking System

Integrated bilty documentation, clear cargo tracking numbers, verified loading registers, and transparent delivery acknowledgments.

Corporate Transport Services

Tailored fleet allocations, contracted freight agreements, and dedicated client dispatch managers for enterprise trade partners across Pakistan.
